name: B10-0070/2026 (Renew) – Attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is passing a resolution: a formal statement of concern and a set of requests. It says Lithuania's government is trying to take political control of its public broadcaster, LRT, by cutting its funding and making it easier to fire its head. It asks the European Commission to check whether Lithuania broke EU media rules and to start legal action if it did.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is an opinion and a call for EU action.
- **Who it affects:** Lithuania's government, LRT and its journalists, and the European Commission.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must decide whether to investigate and possibly take Lithuania to court.
